Package hadur2.core.memory

Class Bytes

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.memory.Bytes
final class Bytes extends Object
Big-endian byte writing and reading for the profile format, without java.io (the core does no I/O, RES-6). The reader throws ProfileFormatException past the end.

Big-endian means most significant byte first, the byte order java.io.DataOutputStream uses. Floats are stored as their IEEE 754 bits, so a value reads back bit for bit.
